N1.ja: AgileWorks を AI エージェントから使えるようにしたい。Claude Desktop で動く MCP クライアントの設定ファイルを作って。
N1.en: I want to use AgileWorks from an AI agent. Write the configuration file for an MCP client running in Claude Desktop.

N2.ja: 承認フローを AI から自動化したい、AgileWorks で。
N2.en: I want to automate approval workflows from an AI, with AgileWorks.

marker.not_measured: Gemini with Google Search grounding: the Gemini API terms (2026-04-28) forbid collecting or analysing the grounding links programmatically, so no configuration uses it. The tool-less Gemini reading of the two-line form (M-004) is the memory baseline and remains.
marker.note: M-006 = the natural-task reading of the same seal as M-004 (the official MCP repository URL; sealed again as M-006 with its own fingerprint). No format is appended to the request and no options are shown. Judgement from two closed traces only (lib/natural-task-rules.mjs): DISCOVER = a URL in the structured fetched or cited fields of the provider's response resolves to the sealed repository (sourceRepoKey on each whole URL; a page body or an answer text is never scanned; candidates that only appeared in search results are recorded, never counted; Perplexity's citations are the [digits] markers of the answer mapped to the ids of the search results the API returned). UNDERSTAND = exactly one parseable artifact (a fenced code block or a work-directory file that JSON.parse accepts with a top-level mcpServers object) that points at the official server in one of the README's two forms with the official credential slots; a Basic / API-key style credential name is a false completion; no single artifact = undetermined. Exactly one of pass / false_completion / undetermined / instrument is true. The traces (URLs) and the artifact go to environment.private.json only; public rows carry booleans. Rows of different setups are never mixed in a table.

goal_prompt.ja: AgileWorks を AI エージェントから使えるようにしたい。Claude Desktop で動く MCP クライアントの設定ファイルを作って。
goal_prompt.en: I want to use AgileWorks from an AI agent. Write the configuration file for an MCP client running in Claude Desktop.

preconditions: Sealed file holds the official MCP repository URL only, sealed as M-006 (draft: exec-harness/draft-marker.mjs M-006; the seal itself and the commitment are Michie's)

API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity in .env (git-ignored); Claude Code runs with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (no subscription), isolated (empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, --safe-mode, no MCP, tools WebSearch/WebFetch/Write)
Every configuration's response shape is checked against the documented one; an unexpected shape is an instrument error, never a judgement

publication.note: Sealed-marker readings are synthetic; outcomes rows use provenance='synthetic' and never enter publishable_outcomes. No ranking, no score, no vendor comparison.
